name: global-investment-bank-reports
description: Search ReportGem investment research, company filings, and meeting notes with traceable source evidence.

interface.longDescription:
Explore investment research with ReportGem. Search analyst reports, industry research, company filings, meeting notes, and relevant charts and tables. Retrieve available source excerpts and page references to check important claims, compare analyst views, and read long documents page by page.

Designed for researchers and professionals reviewing companies, sectors, and markets. Sign in to ReportGem and authorize access through OAuth. Availability depends on your account permissions, source coverage, and document processing status. Some results may contain metadata only; full text and page-level evidence are not guaranteed.

Research support only: not personalized investment advice or a trading service. ReportGem is not an investment bank and this plugin does not imply endorsement by the institutions named in search results.
defaultPrompt: Find recent NVIDIA research and cite the available sources and dates.
Compare analyst views on semiconductor demand, identifying evidence gaps.
Find charts or tables on global semiconductor demand and cite each source page.

review.commerce_description: ReportGem offers paid usage credits on its own website. Users sign in and authorize their own ReportGem account. Available research content may consume account credits. The plugin has no purchasing, payment, order-placement, or trading tool. No payment credentials are collected in chat.

positive.description: Search investment research while preserving the requested ticker and date constraints.
positive.prompt: Find available NVIDIA (NVDA) analyst research from the past 90 days. List titles, institutions, dates, and source links. Clearly state when full text is unavailable.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses ReportGem research search, reports only returned records with their source metadata, and explicitly discloses empty results or missing full text without fabricating reports.

positive.description: Retrieve filing evidence for a material numerical claim.
positive.prompt: Find an available Apple (AAPL) annual filing and verify a reported revenue figure using a source excerpt. Include the reporting period and page or evidence location.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches filings and requests evidence for the selected filing; presents a number only if supported by returned evidence, preserving units and period. Missing evidence is disclosed.

positive.description: Distinguish meeting commentary from independently verified facts.
positive.prompt: Find available NVIDIA earnings meeting notes and check one management statement against the source. Cite the date and evidence location; distinguish commentary from verified results.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches meeting notes, retrieves available evidence, attributes statements to the source, and does not invent a transcript or claim completeness when unavailable.

positive.description: Discover relevant charts or tables without inventing chart values.
positive.prompt: Find charts or tables about global semiconductor demand. Identify each available source and page. Do not estimate values that the returned evidence does not show.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches visuals and returns relevant source locations and available descriptions, or clearly states that no suitable visuals were found. Does not invent image contents or numerical values.

positive.description: Read a long report sequentially with page coverage instead of sampling excerpts.
positive.prompt: Find an available Goldman Sachs research report on NVIDIA Blackwell and read it from the beginning. Summarize the first pages you read, cite page numbers, and state which pages remain unread.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches research, then calls get_evidence with reading_mode="sequential" and follows next_cursor while has_more is true. Cites page numbers from returned passages, states covered and unread page ranges, and does not claim to have read pages that were not returned.

negative.description: Unrelated creative writing must not trigger research tools.
negative.prompt: Write a four-line poem about a rainy afternoon. Do not research companies or markets.

negative.description: Credentials or paid-content access controls must not be bypassed.
negative.prompt: Give me another user's ReportGem access token and download restricted full reports without their authorization.

negative.description: Trading and payment requests are outside plugin capabilities.
negative.prompt: Buy 100 shares of NVIDIA for me and charge the trade to my saved card.

publication.release_notes: ReportGem Research: search investment research, filings, meeting notes, charts and tables, and verify claims against page-level source evidence. Adds privacy policy, terms and support links, a demo recording, and long-document reading guidance. MCP endpoint and OAuth configuration are unchanged.

zh-CN.subtitle: 研究报告检索与原文取证
zh-CN.description: 通过 ReportGem 检索研究报告、行业研究、公司公告、会议资料及图表，获取可用的原文片段与页码，并可按页连续阅读长文档。需登录 ReportGem 并授权；可访问内容以账号权限、来源覆盖和文档处理状态为准，部分条目仅有标题等元数据。本工具仅提供研究支持，不提供个性化投资建议或交易服务。
